cases.name: Quameisha Dashay Branch
cases.about:
Her obituary said, "Quameisha grew and developed into a sweet and compassionate teenager, who met no stranger! Everyone knew Quameisha by her angelic and infectious smile that could easily brighten anyone’s day. Her smile was accompanied by a warm and bubbly personality that earned her the tagname ‘Giggle Box’. She was a beautiful person both internally and externally, who had an unconditional love and loyalty for her family.

Quameisha was a sweet spirit who possessed a thankful heart for the things God gave her whether big or small. She remained positive in all situations and always saw the good in everyone. She loved to dance and to sing. She was also known for texting her close relatives and friends, asking for money :)  Quameisha loved kids and was an absolute joy to be around. She loved her family with all her heart and would do anything she could for them.  To know her was to love her and she was known by many throughout!

 Quameisha was educated in the Northampton School System. She was a proud employee of Hardee’s in Gaston, North Carolina. Her employment was not viewed as mere work, but as a place where she could be herself and embrace those around her with love. It was there where she would give words of encouragement, sing sweet melodies to others and serve her community."
cases.narrative: On 2/10/2023, acting on a tip, police found her body with a gunshot wound to the head, in a field in the area east of Garysburg along Old Highway in Northampton County.
